_: How each installer is run unattended in a fresh Wine prefix to record what it leaves behind (tools/snapshot/record.py). 'installer'+'args', or 'installers' [{asset, args}] run in order, name assets on the system-libraries-v1 release. 'arch' = prefix: win64, or win32 for installers that refuse a 64-bit prefix (.NET 2.0/3.5, Jet); a win32 recording is laid out as on 64-bit Windows unless 'remap' is false. 'timeout' seconds per installer. 'winver' = Windows version set before recording (not recorded). 'after' = recipes installed first, so this one records only its own delta (the app installs them first too). 'host_files' = the placed files travel with the recording (needed when no extractor opens the installer; only where the licence allows, 'licence' says why). 'dll_overrides' = Wine overrides for the run itself (never recorded). 'extract_to' + 'register' = instead of running a wizard with no silent mode, unpack the installer into that drive_c folder and regsvr32 those files (paths under drive_c). 'pre_reg_delete' = registry keys removed before recording (a fresh Wine prefix may claim a .NET it does not have).

K-Lite.licence: The pack's installer is Inno Setup 6.4.2, which no extractor reads yet, so the placed files travel with the recording. What this edition places is open source (LAV Filters, MPC-HC, MPC Video Renderer, DirectVobSub: GPL) plus Icaros, which its author distributes freely.
K-Lite.notes: The pack registers its DirectShow filters with regsvr32 during setup; those CLSID / filter entries are the point of the recording.

lavfilters741.licence: LAV Filters is GPL-2.0; the files travel with the recording so a device needs no Inno Setup extractor.

lavfilters702.licence: LAV Filters is GPL-2.0; the files travel with the recording so a device needs no Inno Setup extractor.

ffdshow.licence: ffdshow is GPL-2.0; the files travel with the recording so a device needs no Inno Setup extractor.

dirac.notes: NSIS wizard with no working silent mode (winetricks clicks through it with AutoHotkey): unpacked into Program Files/Dirac and the two filters registered with regsvr32, in a win32 prefix laid out as on 64-bit Windows. 7-Zip opens the installer on the device. The filters link the VC++ 2008 runtime, installed first (and a catalog dependency).

quicktime72.notes: Apple's redistribution terms do not allow hosting the files: a device takes them from the installer (a cabinet wrapper 7-Zip and cabextract open).

oalinst.notes: NSIS; the DLL-copy twin oalinst_dll already covers most games.

VulkanRT.notes: NSIS (the catalog's /passive is an MSI switch and shows the wizard).

vcredist6sp6.licence: Microsoft Visual C++ 6 runtime redistributable: licensed for redistribution with applications.

jet40.licence: Microsoft Jet 4.0 SP8 redistributable: licensed for redistribution with applications.
jet40.notes: 32-bit only IExpress package (jetsetup.exe inside, INF-driven); /q as winetricks runs it; recorded in a win32 prefix and laid out as on 64-bit Windows.

mdac28.licence: Microsoft Data Access Components 2.8 redistributable: licensed for redistribution with applications.
mdac28.notes: The setup refuses to run on anything after Windows 2000, so the recording's prefix says win2k (the catalog's win98 is the 32-bit Wine convention).

dotnet20.licence: Microsoft .NET Framework 2.0 redistributable: licensed for redistribution with applications.
dotnet20.notes: 32-bit only installer (the x64 one refuses Wine); recorded in a win32 prefix and laid out as on 64-bit Windows.

dotnet20sp1.licence: Microsoft .NET Framework 2.0 SP1 redistributable: licensed for redistribution with applications.
dotnet20sp1.notes: 32-bit only; recorded on top of dotnet20 in a win32 prefix and laid out as on 64-bit Windows. As winetricks does: Windows 2000 for the installer, ngen/regsvcs/mscorsvw stubbed.

dotnet35.licence: Microsoft .NET Framework 3.5 redistributable: licensed for redistribution with applications.
dotnet35.notes: The full redistributable (carries 2.0 SP2 and 3.0 SP2); 32-bit only, recorded in a win32 prefix and laid out as on 64-bit Windows. As winetricks does: mscoree/mscorwks native (no Wine stand-ins), Windows XP.

dotnet35sp1.licence: Microsoft .NET Framework 3.5 SP1 redistributable: licensed for redistribution with applications.
dotnet35sp1.notes: The full redistributable (carries 2.0 SP2 and 3.0 SP2); 32-bit only, recorded in a win32 prefix and laid out as on 64-bit Windows. As winetricks does: mscoree/mscorwks native (no Wine stand-ins), Windows XP.

aairruntime.notes: Adobe's terms do not allow hosting the files; the installer is an archive 7-Zip can open.

art2kmin.notes: Access 2000 runtime: a 7-Zip-openable wrapper around Setup.exe + Data1.msi. Not recorded: the app's MSI engine lays Data1.msi out directly once art2kmin leaves its setup-program list.

webview2.notes: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen standalone installer. Recorded once: 656 files, 576 of them inside a payload no extractor opens, and Microsoft's terms do not allow hosting them. Not linkable; left for a runtime that can run the installer.

gfw.notes: Games for Windows Live client + redistributable (gfwlivesetupmin, two MSIs inside). The files come from the installer on the device; signing in needs Microsoft's live servers, which nothing here records.

vcredist2008.notes: Prerequisite only (dirac's filters link msvcr90): the app installs vcredist2008 through its own MSI engine; this recipe exists so a recording can be made on top of it.
